sophie: heads up — multiple hosted API customers hitting 503s since ~09:12 UTC. Pattern: upstream inference worker container exits during long-context requests. Customers report timeouts and failed requests.

raj: can you paste a representative request id and logs? which model? any commonality on prompt length or tool-calls?

sophie: request id a1f3c2 — model: gptx-22b-quant. Most failures are >8k tokens. Log snippet:```
[2026-03-17T09:13:21Z] infer-runner[pid:4217] ERROR: unexpected exit (code=137, signal=9)
[2026-03-17T09:13:21Z] infer-runner[pid:4217] stderr: runtime: out of memory: GPU memory exceeded while allocating KV cache
[2026-03-17T09:13:21Z] kernel: segfault at 0 ip ...
stack: 0x7f2... 0x400...
```

miguel: looks like progressive KV growth + long context triggering OOM, then segfault on cleanup. We saw similar once when quant profile changed earlier. Can repro locally with a long prompt and streaming enabled. Repro steps:```
# repro (dev box)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"gptx-22b-quant","input":"<~12k tokens>...","stream":true}'
```
If stream + kv-prefetch active, memory climbs until OOM.

leila: any infra churn around 08:45-09:00? autoscaler events? quant rollout?

miguel: we promoted a quant profile for gptx-22b to canary at 08:50 but only 5% traffic. however, canary nodes share the same deploy group as hosted pool A — config bug may have flipped more hosts.

opsbot: [ALERT] 09:14 UTC host=pool-A-queue-7 restart_spike count=38 avg_uptime=3m

anna: mitigation idea: cap max_context at gateway to 8k for hosted tier and route >8k to a fallback CPU/large-memory pool or to gptx-22b-32q (less aggressive quant). Can roll in 10–15m.

raj: approve. Do it. Also enable temporary per-request mem-safeguard: reject requests with stream+prefetch if predicted_mem > 90% capacity.

miguel: implemented routing rule + mem-safeguard at 09:28 UTC. Deployed to prod pool-A. Initial telemetry: container restarts down ~78% and 503s reduced by ~70% for affected customers.

elena: CS: pinged affected customers with workaround and ETA for full fix. Affected: 3 enterprise tenants; we offered temporary dedicated capacity where needed.

sophie: thanks team. Opening follow-up postmortem ticket to track: root-cause (config flip + long-context KV growth), long-term fixes (better mem-prediction, isolated canary hosts, quant rollback plan).

raj: next steps: get full coredump, run heaptrace on reproducer, and schedule rollback window for canary quant if repro confirmed.

miguel: capturing core at 09:35 UTC. will attach repro artifacts.

sophie: closing thread for now — mitigation in place. will update PM + customers after triage. :thumbsup:
